# One-dimensional PDPs for bike rental demand

```{r helper-pdp-1d}
plot_pdp_1d <- function(pdp_data, feature, title, x_label, y_label, rug_data = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot(pdp_data, aes(x = .data[[feature]], y = yhat)) +
    geom_line(size = 1, color = "#2D4F73") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  if (!is.null(rug_data)) {
    p <- p + geom_rug(
      data = rug_data,
      aes(x = .data[[feature]]),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      sides = "b",
      alpha = 0.25,
      color = "#5A4635"
    )
  }

  return(p)
}
```

Sections for `days_since_2011`, `temp`, `hum`, and `windspeed` are included in the main notebook; this fragment contains the helper and can be used to run each 1D PDP independently.
